summary: Added Graph.cbd(resource) to rdflib/graph.py as the last Graph method before ConjunctiveGraph. It implements the W3C CBD rules 1 and 2 (reification via rdf:subject, no rdf:Statement or predicate/object checks), with a nested add_to_cbd helper and a cycle guard. Added test/test_graph_cbd.py with CbdTestCase covering the count fixtures, typed/untyped reifiers, incoming reification, blank-node non-expansion, blank-node cycles, and source immutability. Tests were not run, per instructions; all verification was by reading. The fixtures are my own, sized to match the spec's totals, since the reference fixture was not available. Nothing was committed.
